title: Jurisdiction Pack
description: Supplies everything region-specific: which standards apply, the physical constants Branch Physics evaluates against, and which fault-tree rule set a manifest referencing this jurisdiction should be evaluated with. See ARCHITECTURE.md Section 5.

standards.description: e.g. LVS_EN_50110_1, EN_50699, OSHA_1910_S, IEC_60364 — was a hardcoded literal on every manifest in VoltWatch v2.0; now lives here.

resistivityOhmMm2PerM.description: Material key -> resistivity in Ohm*mm^2/m. Keys correspond to manifest.branch.material values for this jurisdiction.

continuousLoadDeratePct.description: e.g. 0.8 for the NEC/IEC 80% continuous-load breaker rule

faultTreeRef.description: id@version of a rules/fault-trees/*.json pack, e.g. 'voltage-probe-4point@1.1.0'
